title: Generalize Trinity Directed Port Graph
description: Trinity operates on general directed property port graphs, not DAGs. Remove DAG-only canvas assumptions (enforce_acyclic), wire reorganize to shared force layout, generalize flatPosition derivation for disconnected components, and extend force-graph schema allowlist.
summary: Fixed S play end-to-end boot after V1 fixture rename strip: updated puzzle/2d/play and puzzle/5d/play imports (parsePuzzle2dFixture, clonePuzzle2dFixture, Puzzle2dFixture, drag MIME constants), guarded cad/js/renderer/play from self-booting when PUZZLE_PLAY_ENTRY=s (was hijacking #root with CAD chrome), added cad playEntryKind. Verified in browser: Media Graph + App Host + demo instances render, no [DEBUG] boot errors, 8/8 s-play tests pass.
